fn codex_root_option_takes_value(argument: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        argument,
        "-c" | "--config"
            | "--enable"
            | "--disable"
            | "-i"
            | "--image"
            | "-m"
            | "--model"
            | "--local-provider"
            | "--profile"
            | "-s"
            | "--sandbox"
            | "-a"
            | "--ask-for-approval"
            | "-C"
            | "--cd"
            | "--add-dir"
    )
}
